steps.note: Cream is mixed into the finished skimmed-milk quark to bring it to the grade (Fettstufe, 40 % fat in dry matter).

sources.text: That the fat grades are not set in the milk but by mixing cream into the finished skimmed-milk quark, since standardising the milk would lose fat with the whey.
